questions.question: You have experience designing workflows, SLAs, assignments, and business rules in Pega PRPC. How would you apply that workflow-design experience when building or customizing business processes in Dynamics 365 ERP?

Describe a SOAP service or connector integration you implemented in Pega. What was the interface design, how did you troubleshoot failures, and how would you approach a similar integration in a Dynamics 365 and Azure environment?

This role requires technical oversight of custom entities, workflows, and integrations. How would you document a technical design so developers, business analysts, QA, and stakeholders share the same understanding of the solution?
What is your experience with SQL and database testing, and how would you use SQL to investigate a data issue affecting an ERP supply-chain process?

You have used debugging tools such as Clipboard, Tracer, and Rules Inspector in Pega. Walk through your general debugging process for a production workflow defect, from reproducing the issue through validating the fix.
Describe how you have translated a business requirement—such as an account-opening workflow—into UI, validation, routing, decision logic, and reporting components.
What practices would you establish to ensure quality in a Dynamics 365 development team, including code review, testing, defect triage, and deployment validation?
How would you lead and support developers working across concurrent D365 enhancement requests while maintaining delivery timelines and technical consistency?
What supply-chain business processes do you understand today, and how would you partner with operations stakeholders to learn the process details needed for a Dynamics 365 ERP solution?

Describe your experience working with QA artifacts such as test plans, test cases, traceability matrices, test data, and defect reports. How would you incorporate those practices into an Agile D365 delivery process?
